title.en: An Act to Amend Section three of Act Numbered Twenty-Seven Hundred and Twenty-Eight, Entitled "An Act Creating the Bureau of Commerce and Industry, Defining Its Functions, Making Appropriations thereof, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
Paragraph (e) of section three of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and twenty-eight is
hereby amended to read as follows:
"(e) To organize, establish, create, maintain, and regulate, and whenever it may deem it proper, authorize the
creation, under such regulations as it may prescribe, of commercial exchanges and other public places of
exchange, and to suspend and abolish the same, as it may see fit; to qualify, approve, authorize, and license
for periods not to exceed three years, as exchange agents, merchandise brokers, ship brokers and interpreters
and real-estate brokers, and to suspend and revoke said licenses or any of them for cause; and to organize and
authorize associations of exchange agents, merchandise brokers, ship brokers and interpreters and real estate
brokers, subject to such regulations as it may prescribe, and to consolidate, suspend and dissolve the same."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 2, 1932.
